(Shantira Beach Resort & Spa) là khu ngh: (Shantira Beach Resort & Spa) is an 8.6 ha resort on Lac Long Quan Street, Dien Duong (former Dien Ban, now part of Da Nang City), adjacent to An Bang Beach and about 5 minutes from Hoi An Ancient Town.
